chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: Musicians whose wives took their money and found other men
summary: Danny and Milt recall musicians like Simmons, Russell Smith and DePriest Wheeler who sent their pay home, only to lose out to other men.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: The same thing with Simmons, him and his wife. He'd send his money home just as dutiful(?) as to keep his alliance. And his wife had another man, and he had a kid...
Yeah... Russell Smith was the same. It happened to Russell Smith the same way.

The woman would raise some hell if he didn't send that money. We got paid around four o'clock, and if that money wasn't somewhere at five, the phone would ring. Cats were talking(?), because I think that's(?) what happened.
